verdict.rationale: Veo is a general text/image-to-video model rather than an avatar-presenter tool. It generates native dialogue that users praise as on par with dedicated voice models, supports image inputs and character consistency, and so can produce a speaking person from a prompt with no camera. There is no documented script-to-presenter workflow and no stock avatar library. Clips are short (around 8 seconds). Hands-on reports note that image-to-video redraws the source so it barely resembles it, and that moderation blocked a cartoon of a user talking, which weakens custom-avatar use. Missing for 10: a dedicated paste-script-to-presenter workflow, a stock avatar library, reliable custom-avatar likeness from user images, support for long-form scripts, and hands-on evidence of presenter-style marketing videos.
